kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتأيرن (form IIq)
# أَتَأَيْرَنُ (ʔataʔayranu) /ʔa.ta.ʔaj.ra.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# أَتَأَيْرَنَ (ʔataʔayrana) /ʔa.ta.ʔaj.ra.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
# أَتَأَيْرَنْ (ʔataʔayran) /ʔa.ta.ʔaj.ran/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَيْرَنَ (taʔayrana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
